This '''mansion''' was owned by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Rilvvan K'ntarr]] in [[Ryell]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rydonni Prime]]. K'ntarr held a ceremony here at some point after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in honor of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Caerbellak]].<ref name="Easy">{{JournalCite|9|Easy Credits}}</ref>
